{{Quote|Look, it's the general!|This clone trooper noticing Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="ARC Troopers" />}}
This '''clone trooper''' participated in the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="ARC Troopers" />

==Biography==
During the battle of assault on [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], this [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|trooper]] and the rest of his squad held back the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid Army|Droid army]] from an elevated position with their [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]]. To the end of the battle, this clone trooper noticed [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] dueling with [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and along with the rest of the squad, came down to assist him.<ref name="ARC Troopers" />
